description_en: Queries the operation logs of Public DNS
description_zh: 获取公共DNS 操作日志列表
kebab_example: aliyun alidns describe-pdns-operate-logs --lang example-string --action-type example-string --keyword example-string --start-date example-string --end-date example-string --page-number 1 --page-size 1 --resource-type example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePdnsOperateLogs

parameters.help_en: Specifies the language for the request and response. Valid values: zh for Chinese and en for English. Default value: zh
parameters.help_zh: 设置请求和接收消息的语言类型。zh 表示中文，en 表示英文；默认为 zh
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The operation type. Valid values: ADD, UPDATE, and DELETE
parameters.help_zh: 操作类型，可选 ADD（新增）、UPDATE（更新）或 DELETE（删除）
parameters.name: action_type

parameters.help_en: The keyword used to filter operation content
parameters.help_zh: 按操作内容筛选的查询关键词
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The start date for the query. Format: YYYY-MM-DD
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始日期，格式为 YYYY-MM-DD
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The end date for the query. Format: YYYY-MM-DD
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束日期，格式为 YYYY-MM-DD
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return per page in a paging query
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页返回的记录数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Valid values: HTTPDNS and UDP
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型，可选 HTTPDNS 或 UDP
parameters.name: resource_type

Logs.description_en: The list of operation logs for Public DNS
Logs.description_zh: 公共 DNS 操作日志列表

items.description_en: A single entry in the Public DNS operation logs
items.description_zh: 单条公共 DNS 操作日志

Action.description_en: The operation action. For example, ADD indicates a creation operation
Action.description_zh: 操作行为，例如 ADD 表示新增

OperateTime.description_en: The time when the operation was performed. The time is in the UTC+8 time zone. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
OperateTime.description_zh: 操作发生时间，北京时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

Type.description_en: The type of the business resource involved in the operation
Type.description_zh: 操作涉及的业务资源类型

content.description_en: The content of the operation log

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned result

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 返回结果每页的记录数

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries that meet the query conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合查询条件的记录总数
